Bug_Title: Consumed Stream pipelines should not be reused
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded by attempting to reuse a stream pipeline after it has already been consumed by the terminal operation 'findAny'. The second operation 'mapToInt' is applied to the same stream, which results in an IllegalStateException because streams cannot be reused after a terminal operation.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case calls the showBug method which attempts to reuse a consumed Stream pipeline. This triggers the bug by causing an IllegalStateException due to the reuse of a stream after a terminal operation.
